catalog.archive_scope: Root repository only; recursive Git submodule payloads are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Build the selected x86 CPU compiler and runtime/example closure in dev against the tested LLVM tuple; pin target ISA and gang width. Run precompiled objects and C/C++ harnesses on target.
catalog.purpose: SPMD vectorization, SIMD code-generation baselines and C/C++ interoperation experiments on the same x86 CPU.
qualification_gaps: The selected CMake requires LLVM 20 or later, but that minimum does not certify every later LLVM API combination.
Upstream superbuild/quick-start paths can download patched LLVM; cache and pin that exact closure before experiments.
SPMD source rewrites change the programming model and must be analyzed as a separate study from unchanged-source general-purpose compiler optimization.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
